title: A lake rebuilt for the city
text: Fateh Sagar’s history includes an early reservoir under Maharana Jai Singh and later enlargement associated with Maharana Fateh Singh. The changing name reflects that later intervention. The lake is more than a scenic stop: its story connects royal patronage, engineering and the work of maintaining water in a dry landscape.
